newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece raises 70 bln drachmas from CPI-bonds.
newsitem.headline: Greece raises 70 bln drachmas from CPI-bonds.

text.p: Greece raised about 70 billion drachmas on a provisional basis from the sale of five-and 10-year coupon and principal CPI-indexed bonds, the first to hit the local market, the finance ministry said in a statement.
"This issue has covered 30 percent of the annual target," it said.
The finance ministry has said it wants to raise 300 billion drachmas from the sale of CPI-indexed bonds in 1997.
The 4.0 percent, five-and 10-year CPI-indexed bonds went on sale today. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
